findings.summary: Hovering another trigger after a click leaves the new popup pinned. Gallery has one click trigger, no hover or multi-trigger use.
Removing the focused element leaves focus on body in Firefox and WebKit (popups).
Pressing inside a later-opened modal Dialog closes the Popover with outside-press. Gallery does not nest them.
Non-modal Popover stays open when interacting inside a same-origin iframe. Not used.
Opening in a local portal briefly scrolls ancestor and flickers. Gallery uses the default portal.
onOpenChange(false) fired twice in Firefox when Tab leaves the popup; fixed.
onOpenChange(false) fired again with reason focus-out; fixed.

notChecked: Reddit, Hacker News and blog posts (only GitHub issue search for mui/base-ui, shadcn-ui/ui, radix-ui/primitives)

differences.reference: After clicking empty page area, popover closes and document.activeElement is BODY (focus is not moved to the trigger).
differences.branch: After clicking empty page area, popover closes and focus returns to the trigger button (activeElement is the Open popover button).
differences.how: Open /gallery#components, scroll to #popover, click Open popover, click empty area right of the content column, read document.activeElement.

differences.where: Open popup position and animation origin
differences.branch: Popup at x=1272.5,y=191.5 (half-pixel), transform-origin 128px -4px (offset by sideOffset), so the zoom-in-95 animation starts from a point 4px different. Static screenshots look identical.
differences.how: Open popover, compare getBoundingClientRect() and getComputedStyle(popup).transformOrigin.

differences.reference: Trigger has data-state=open|closed, no tabindex; popup in a fixed wrapper div.
differences.branch: Trigger has explicit tabindex=0, data-popup-open and data-pressed while open instead of data-state; popup wrapped in a Positioner div role=presentation inside a portal container. Focus moves into the popup (tabindex -1) in both.
differences.how: Inspect trigger and popup attributes in each build.

differences.reference: Exports PopoverAnchor; PopoverTitle renders a div.
differences.branch: No PopoverAnchor export (unused in src); PopoverTitle renders a real heading via PopoverPrimitive.Title; extra side/alignOffset props on Content.
differences.how: Diff radix-nova and base-nova popover registry files.

apiChanges: asChild becomes render on PopoverTrigger (children move out of the element)
notes: Swap was applied, compared, then reverted. Not checked: 390x844 (window resize ignored), Tab/Shift+Tab visual focus ring, frame-by-frame animation, reduced motion, gates (not run since flagged).
reasonNotMoved: Outside-click behaviour differs: on Radix focus ends on body after an outside click, on Base UI it returns to the trigger (verified in browser). The popup also positions at half-pixel offsets and its zoom animation origin differs by 4px (128px -4px vs 128px 0px), and the trigger gets tabindex=0 and different state attributes. Retry if Base UI offers a way to not restore focus on outside press and the transform origin can be matched; re-run the comparison then.
